blocks.text: Across the verified quotes, two priorities recur. First, profitability and growth across divisions: the Q1 release and the half-year report both point to improved profit. Second, the Technical Trade and grocery-related growth areas: Rauhala names Technical Trade as the headline driver, and when discussing retail media he links it mainly to the grocery business. Markets in Finland and Norway are described as still muted but improved. These are public signals only and are offered as a reason to ask questions, not as a diagnosis of internal processes.
